verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a government online-services platform, since such an agency could offer a conversational assistant, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only form-based online registration, account e-services and EFILE software transmission, with no natural-language or conversational command interface. The probes show no agent-oriented docs index (llms.txt soft-404s), which says nothing in favor of NL operation.
